remarks:
Welcome to 179 N 2nd Street, a solid 1963 ranch on a quiet neighborhood cul-de-sac in the Village of Allegany. Offering 1,674 sq ft of true one-level living, this 3-bedroom, 2-full-bath home sits on a 0.28-acre rectangular lot (75 x 160) and is ready for its next chapter.

The heart of the home is the eat-in kitchen, featuring an island with a built-in electric cooktop, a breakfast bar, a built-in wall oven, and plenty of cabinet space. It opens to a warm, knotty pine family room with exposed beams, a wood-burning brick fireplace with mantel, built-in cabinetry, and a large bay window overlooking the yard. Three first-floor bedrooms with ceiling fans, two full baths, and a convenient first-floor laundry room make everyday living easy.

Outside, enjoy a covered porch, deck, and patio, plus an attached 1-car garage with an opener and a blacktop driveway. The full poured basement offers excellent storage or room to expand. Public water and sewer, gas forced-air heat, a gas water heater, and high-speed internet.

Located in the Allegany-Limestone School District, just minutes from Route 417, St. Bonaventure, and everything Olean has to offer. With great bones and a fantastic location, this home is a wonderful opportunity to add your personal touches and build equity. Schedule your showing today!
